expected_root_cause: A bounded CPU burn workload saturated the order-service container.
expected_symptoms: Order request latency increases and CPU throttling may occur.
No deployment event precedes the resource spike.
expected_evidence: cAdvisor container_cpu_usage_seconds_total rises sharply for order-service.
Container CPU throttling metrics may increase when limits are configured.
Prometheus request-duration metrics increase while CPU is saturated.
Docker process inspection shows the bounded CPU burn process in order-service.
expected_resolution: Stop the injected bounded CPU burn process and confirm the process exits, CPU usage drops, and order latency returns to baseline.

timeline.event: Capture normal order-service CPU usage and request latency.
Start the bounded CPU burn workload in order-service.
Container CPU usage spikes and request latency increases.
Stop the injected workload and verify CPU and latency recover.
